deals.headline: Mark Walter buys control of the Lakers from the Buss family at ~$10bn
deals.summary: Agreed in June 2025; the Buss family kept just over 15% and Jeanie Buss stayed governor. Closed after unanimous NBA Board of Governors approval (Lakers release, 30 October 2025).

deals.evidence: The Los Angeles Lakers are being sold to Josh Kushner and Bob Iger for $12.5 billion, a record-breaking price, multiple sources told ESPN.
deals.headline: Josh Kushner and Bob Iger agree to buy the Lakers at $12.5bn
deals.summary: Kushner (founder of Thrive Capital) and Iger agreed to buy roughly 65% from Walter; requires NBA Board of Governors approval and Kushner must first sell his Miami Heat stake. ESPN: 'Kushner and Iger are purchasing approximately 65% of the franchise in their deal with Walter.'

deals.evidence: The Buss family has decided to sell its remaining 17.8% stake in the Los Angeles Lakers to new majority owners Josh Kushner and Bob Iger
deals.headline: Buss siblings vote to sell the trust's remaining 17.8% via tag-along
deals.summary: Five of six siblings voted to tag along with Walter's sale; Jeanie Buss petitioned Los Angeles Superior Court to block it, joined in retaining a stake by minority owners Soon-Shiong and Roski.

ownership_summary: Mark Walter (CEO of TWG Global) has held a majority stake since the NBA approved his purchase from the Buss family in October 2025 at a ~$10bn valuation; he first bought Philip Anschutz's 26% in 2021 alongside Todd Boehly. The Buss Family Trust retained a minority stake (17.8% per ESPN); Patrick Soon-Shiong and Ed Roski are minority owners. In August 2026 Walter agreed to sell about 65% to Josh Kushner and Bob Iger at a $12.5bn valuation, pending NBA approval; five Buss siblings voted to tag along with the trust's 17.8%, which Jeanie Buss is contesting in court.
